title: Browser extension (Manifest V3)

mv3.scaffold: manifest.json (manifest_version 3) + service worker; package.json with vitest and @playwright/test

tools.why: load the unpacked extension in Chromium for end-to-end tests

S0.run: unit tests (vitest/jest) for background, content and popup logic

S1.how: Playwright image: chromium.launchPersistentContext with --load-extension=<dist>, check the service worker and content script; web-ext lint for Firefox

S3.how: GitHub Actions ubuntu runner with xvfb-run (headed Chromium loads extensions)

release: Chrome Web Store: privacy practices, single purpose, a justification for every permission and host permission
Firefox AMO: web-ext lint clean; upload sources when the build is minified
no remotely hosted code (MV3); bump the version in manifest.json for every upload

mv3.mutation: npx --yes -p @stryker-mutator/core@10.0.0 stryker run --testRunner command --mutate 'src/**/*.{js,jsx,ts,tsx}'   # runs your test command against each mutant; slow, run on logic-heavy modules
mv3.codemod: npx expo install --fix (Expo) / React Native Upgrade Helper

rollback: No instant rollback. Chrome Web Store: publish the previous code with a higher version; use percentage rollout for large user bases. AMO: disable the bad version, upload a fixed one.
observe: error reporting from the service worker and content scripts (Sentry)

policies.what: Chrome no longer runs Manifest V2 extensions (phased out 2024–2025): ship MV3 only.
